correctness.rationale: An exhaustive integer chain computation for the finite domain 3<=n<=9 generates all matching faces and signed boundaries, and reduces every nonzero boundary matrix by only +/-1 unimodular pivots to zero residual. For n=9 the face numbers 27,216,555,324 and ranks 26,190,323 give H2=Z^42 and H3=Z; for all earlier n the exact integral boundary ranks show at most one positive degree. The standalone verifier was executed with its recorded output reproduced.

value.rationale: Complements of cycles are canonical antihole graphs. The sharp first mixed-degree integral matching homology threshold at order nine, with the precise ranks and torsion-free statement, is a natural finite invariant that complete-graph matching-complex theorems do not determine. It can inform later deletion/link and symmetry analyses; no unproved downstream theorem is claimed.
